title: Sending on a channel
hints: An unbuffered channel send blocks until another goroutine receives. Greet sends before returning, but the receiver only gets the channel after Greet returns, so nobody can ever receive.
Do the send in a new goroutine, so Greet can return the channel straight away.
ch := make(chan string); go func() { ch <- "Hello, " + name + "!" }(); return ch
